title: Finite physical gate driver investigation in a SKY130 PFET regulator
evidence_class: Recorded native compact model simulations and explicitly labelled isolated fixtures
conclusion: None of these five driver families meets the combined supply rejection and transient target. The separately selected power refinement is documented independently.

model_provenance.parasitics: Native compact model charge. Default zero diffusion areas and perimeters. No extracted layout.

common_fixture.power_boundary: VIN overhead is current supplied by VIN less the ideal external load. Reference source current is separate. A complete on chip reference and bias generator is absent.
common_fixture.removed_capacitor: Original 100 pF C to ground is removed in the reported compensation cases.
common_fixture.supply_metric: 20 log10 magnitude of VOUT divided by physical VIN ripple. A positive number is supply amplification.
common_fixture.pole_scope: Nonempty native pole lists at the stated operating points. No inference about untested loads, corners or large signal convergence.

variants.current_balance: DL injects PB current into C. P2 width is reduced to rebalance the sensing node. At G, MF and PH source the ND sink current.

recorded_parameters.gm_status: Not recorded for this selected connected point. No inferred numerical gm is reported.

variants.rejection: The 0.1 pF example exits the valid supply range in the load transient. Larger compensation can remove the reported endpoint RHP poles but amplifies MHz supply ripple.

variants.current_balance: At C about 0.35 V, the LVT NFET array sinks the sum of MF and PH currents without a separate level shift node.

isolated_command_capacitance.evidence: Native isolated command current fixture, all other driver terminals AC fixed.

variants.parameter_scope: Native unit current curves establish bias and integer multiplicity. Complete gm and ro tables were not saved.
variants.rejection: None of eight compensation cases has only LHP poles at all three tested loads. No acceptable transient is established.

variants.current_balance: The additional output sourced PFET supplies about 5.68 microampere into G at nominal load.
variants.rejection: At zero external load, G exceeds O and ML transfers current into O. The output rises to about 1.190 V. Static regulation fails and no dynamic acceptance is inferred.

variants.current_balance: NL sources current from VIN into G under control of O. The output connects only to the NL gate. ND multiplicity is increased to balance this added current.

isolated_NL_unit.ro_status: Not saved in the isolated fixture. Retained symbolically in the model.

variants.rejection: The 5 pF and 5 kilohm setting has no reported RHP poles at three loads with 200 pF output capacitance, but amplifies MHz ripple and fails the load transient. Increasing output capacitance to 1 nF introduces RHP poles at 5 mA.

variants.current_balance: The diode adds gm plus 1 over ro damping at high G. Its current is included in VIN overhead.
variants.rejection: The diode stabilizes zero load with 0.1 pF compensation but leaves two RHP poles at 5 mA. The 5 pF cases pass only the three recorded pole checks and still amplify MHz supply ripple. No separate diode transient was performed.

numerical_boundary: Negative output voltages in failed transient trajectories mark model excursions outside the intended regulator domain. They are failure diagnostics, not qualified electrical performance.
reporting_boundary: These are exploratory alternatives rather than the final selected power cell. No silicon, layout extraction, Spectre or PVT qualification is claimed.
